note: PRD-649 shadow calibration scenes, on the PRD-638 pipeline (gi/export.py, scripts/unreal-look/gi.ts). Each scene folder holds scene.py (authored in Unreal), criteria.md (what the judge looks for), and the exported scene.glb and scene.json. A template-lit scene is lit by Unreal's default level, one level per sun, so its shadows are the ones a fresh project casts. Shadow cells are judged at L5 with fog and clouds off, so neither GI nor fog can hide or add a shadow; L9 is the look a player sees. sg.ShadowQuality 3 is Epic, the level of the ThreeNative `high` tier (PRD-644, PRD-652).
